# Labs for this section

Step-by-step wiki pages, in the same spirit as the labs on [albertprofe.dev](https://albertprofe.dev){.external target="_blank"}. The code lives in a separate repo, [AlbertProfe/wikiml-foundations](https://github.com/AlbertProfe/wikiml-foundations){.external target="_blank"}, so you can open the notebooks in Colab.

## Taxi Lab

The story behind the loop is [The learning loop](ml-learning-loop.qmd).

- [Lab#FU01-1: Taxi fare, pure Python](mlab01-1.qmd) — guess, predict, error, nudge, on three receipts.
- [Lab#FU01-2: Taxi fare, NumPy and scikit-learn](mlab01-2.qmd) — a pickup fee, two parameters, and `LinearRegression`.

The Helsinki MOOC itself has exercises on [programming-24.mooc.fi](https://programming-24.mooc.fi){.external target="_blank"}; my [Python notes](/python/python-index.qmd) are companions to that course, not a replacement for its labs.

A site-wide list of annotated external exercises from January 2025 still lives at the [labs index](/labs/labs-index.qmd).
